tbesh_html:
Someone from Greece, founded by Java who was a man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.2;
son of: Japheth (H3315);
brother of: Gomer (H1586), Magog (H4031), Madai (H4074), Tubal (H8422), Meshech (H4902) and Tiras (H8494);
father of: Elishah (H0473), Tarshish (H8659), Kittim (H3794) and Dodanim (H1721); also called Greek at Jol.3.6 + NT.
Group of ya.van (יָוָן "Javan" H3120)
Grecian, Ionian

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a Jevanite, or descendant of Javan
